card.name: Word right after a negation
card.fires_on: The word right after not, no, isn't or haven't, most often "enough", also "coincidence", "accident" or "another". It marks a negated claim in news or web prose.

modes.label: Not enough
modes.description: The word "enough" follows a negation, as in "not enough" or "not far enough".
